state.objective: Adversarially test a client-only inventory compression proposal without inventing accounts or general counter-site dimensions.
confirmed_facts: There are 11 on-hand families: one merchandise inventory and ten shopping-bag families split by plastic/paper and size.
There are 28 BDP/in-transit families: 14 named locations for merchandise and 14 named locations for shopping bags.
There are two damage/loss allowance families, one for merchandise and one for shopping bags.
Round 1 supported item dimensions conditionally, kept on-hand versus transit versus allowance as distinct accounting natures, and rejected a general counter_site_id.
Round 1 conditionally supported ten bag families to one, each set of 14 transit-location families to one, and two allowance families to one when policies and reconciliation align.
Round 1 did not support merging merchandise and bags from names alone and left Disposed Inventory and two loss-expense accounts unresolved.
Operational shipment documents can store shipment_id, origin_site_id, destination_site_id, dispatch date, receipt date and ownership/control-transfer status.
No policy, entries, balances, shipment samples or reconciliation has yet been provided.

candidate_mapping.on_hand: Keep Merchandise Inventory provisionally separate; compress ten shopping-bag on-hand GLs to one Shopping Bag Inventory only after policy validation.
candidate_mapping.transit: Compress 14 merchandise BDP location GLs to one Merchandise In Transit and 14 bag BDP location GLs to one Shopping Bags In Transit after location meaning and cut-off validation.
candidate_mapping.allowance: Compress two allowance GLs to one Inventory Damage/Loss Allowance only if measurement and reporting are common, with inventory_class detail.
candidate_mapping.unresolved: Do not map Disposed Inventory or merge damage/loss expense accounts until postings and workflow are inspected.

mapping_quality.instructions: Which assessment best fits the candidate mapping?

criteria.conditional: Sound target hypothesis with explicit evidence gates.
criteria.too_aggressive: Even conditionally, the proposed dimensional compression is unsound.
criteria.too_conservative: All merchandise and bag balances should already be one GL regardless of policy.

twenty_eight_to_two.instructions: If each named location is only a shipment location and both location sets reconcile by inventory class, is reducing 28 BDP GLs to two transit GLs reasonable?

criteria.yes_conditional: Yes: merchandise transit and shopping-bag transit, with shipment/location detail outside the natural account.
criteria.retain_28: No, location must remain encoded in GL.
criteria.one: Reduce directly to one transit GL without validating class treatment.

site_id_sufficiency.instructions: Is a single journal site_id always sufficient to control and explain an in-transit balance?

criteria.no: The shipment subledger must retain origin, destination, dispatch/receipt and control-transfer status; journal may reference shipment and relevant accounting site.
criteria.yes: One site_id alone always explains transit.
criteria.two_gl_sites: Encode origin and destination into separate natural GLs.

ho_unit_only.instructions: Given HO-controlled movement and no unit-to-unit process, should the system enforce allowed HO-to-unit/unit-to-HO routes in the transfer workflow rather than adding counter_site_id to the COA?

criteria.workflow: Yes, validate routes on shipment/transfer documents.
criteria.coa: Create natural accounts for every HO-unit route.
criteria.journal_dimension: Add a mandatory general counter_site_id to every posting.

ownership_cutoff.instructions: Can dispatch and receipt dates alone determine when BDP is recognized?

criteria.no: Recognition also depends on ownership/control-transfer terms and policy.

bag_asset_or_expense.instructions: Before retaining even one Shopping Bag Inventory GL, must the client verify whether bags are controlled inventory/supplies and when they are expensed?

criteria.yes: Validate recognition, counting, valuation and consumption/issue point.
criteria.no: The word Kantong proves inventory treatment.

one_inventory_account.instructions: Does dimensional design require all gross inventory classes to use one natural account?

criteria.no: Use dimensions within the number of natural accounts justified by different accounting/reporting treatment.
criteria.yes: Every inventory class must use a single GL.
criteria.target_count: Choose solely based on the desired total COA count.

allowance_merge_gate.instructions: What would block merging the two allowance families?

criteria.different_method: Different measurement, posting, presentation, tax or reporting treatment that cannot be reliably reported by inventory_class.
criteria.different_items: Different items always require separate GLs.

clearing_balance.instructions: Should aged or unexplained transit balances be solved by creating more location GLs?

criteria.no: Use shipment aging, reconciliation, exception workflow and cut-off controls.
criteria.yes: Create additional GLs for each exception.

safe_approval_now.instructions: What can be approved before client evidence is obtained?

criteria.architecture: Approve item/shipment dimensions and candidate mapping; leave GL merges conditional.
criteria.all_merges: Approve the proposed GL reductions immediately.
criteria.none: Do not design dimensions or mappings.

required_evidence.instructions: Which package best closes the inventory decision?

criteria.full: Inventory policy, item master, sample receipts/issues/transfers, normal balances, shipment aging/cut-off, allowance roll-forward, opening mapping and subledger reconciliation.

next_after_inventory.instructions: After bank, assets and inventory identity, which supplied COA pattern should be examined next for dimensional compression?

criteria.expense_categories: Repeated expense types and payroll components, while preserving distinct natural expense natures.
criteria.interunit: Create counter-site accounts despite the confirmed no-unit-to-unit model.
criteria.nothing: No further COA families should be reviewed.
criteria.random_merge: Merge accounts based only on similar wording.
